abstract: Two cell surface antigens, brushin and FT-1 were effective in analysis of the process of visceral endoderm differentiation. Brushin was detected on both primitive and visceral endoderm, while FT-1 was detected only on visceral endoderm. When aggregates of N4-1 embryonal carcinoma cells were exposed to 10(-8) M-retinoic acid for more than 2 days, external cells differentiated to multilayered and vacuolized visceral endoderm. However, aggregates treated with 10(-6) M-retinoic acid developed an endoderm layer, which remained one cell thick and was not vacuolized. Cell surface properties of the endoderm cells indicated that the high concentration of retinoic acid inhibited the differentiation pathway at the stage between primitive endoderm cells and visceral endoderm cells. By pulsed exposure to 10(-6) M-retinoic acid, the period sensitive to the high concentration of retinoic acid was shown to be around day 4 after the initial exposure to retinoic acid.
abstract_ja: ブラシン（brushin）とFT-1という2つの細胞表面抗原は、臓側内胚葉への分化過程の解析に有効であった。ブラシンは原始内胚葉と臓側内胚葉の両方で検出されたが、FT-1は臓側内胚葉でのみ検出された。N4-1胎児性癌細胞の凝集体を10⁻⁸ Mのレチノイン酸に2日より長く曝露すると、外側の細胞は多層で空胞化した臓側内胚葉へ分化した。一方、10⁻⁶ Mのレチノイン酸で処理した凝集体では、内胚葉層は1細胞層の厚さのままで空胞化しなかった。内胚葉細胞の細胞表面特性から、高濃度のレチノイン酸は原始内胚葉細胞と臓側内胚葉細胞の間の段階で分化経路を阻害することが示された。10⁻⁶ Mのレチノイン酸を一時的に曝露させる実験により、高濃度レチノイン酸に感受性の高い時期は、初回曝露後およそ4日目頃であることが示された。
